面板值 = 基础值 ×（1 + 百分比加成）+ 固定加成: Panel value = base value × (1 + percentage bonus) + flat bonus
取当前角色的人物、弧盘和其他正式基础值；不取受击目标。: Uses the current character's character, Arc and other official base values; the hit target is not used.
取当前角色装备、养成与命中时有效 Buff 的同属性百分比项。: Uses the same-stat percentage terms from the current character's equipment, progression and Buffs active on hit.
取当前角色装备、账号家具加成与命中时有效 Buff 的同属性固定项。: Uses the same-stat flat terms from the current character's equipment, account furniture bonuses and Buffs active on hit.
技能倍率 = 等级倍率 ×（1 + 倍率修正合计）: Skill ratio = level ratio × (1 + total ratio modifiers)
取攻击方本条正式伤害项；按该技能当前有效等级读取倍率档。: Uses this official damage entry of the attacker; the ratio tier is read at the skill's current effective level.
取攻击方当前养成与 Buff 中，正式作用于该技能标签的倍率修正。: Uses the ratio modifiers in the attacker's current progression and Buffs that officially apply to this skill tag.
最终直伤 = 向下取整[max(0, 技能倍率 × 对应面板 × 增伤 × 暴击: Final direct damage = floor[max(0, skill ratio × matching panel × DMG bonus × CRIT × defense × RES × vulnerability × Π independent DMG bonuses)]
取攻击方本条正式伤害项与当前有效技能等级。: Uses this official damage entry of the attacker and the current effective skill level.
取攻击方命中时的攻击、生命或防御面板；具体哪一种由伤害项指定。: Uses the attacker's ATK, HP or DEF panel at the moment of the hit; the damage entry decides which one.
取攻击方命中时适用于本击的通用、属性、技能与状态增伤。: Uses the general, elemental, skill and state DMG bonuses that apply to this hit from the attacker on hit.
暴击率/固定策略与暴击伤害取攻击方或本机制正式规则。: CRIT rate/fixed policy and CRIT DMG come from the attacker or this mechanic's official rule.
角色等级和防御穿透取攻击方；防御与防御降低取受击目标。: Character level and DEF penetration come from the attacker; defense and DEF reduction come from the hit target.
属性穿透取攻击方；对应属性抗性与减抗取受击目标。: Elemental penetration comes from the attacker; the matching elemental RES and RES reduction come from the hit target.
取受击目标在本击时点承受的伤害提升。: Uses the DMG taken increase the hit target has at this hit's timestamp.
取所有明确作用于攻击方本击的独立最终乘数，逐项相乘。: Uses every independent final multiplier that explicitly applies to this hit of the attacker, multiplied term by term.
增伤倍率 = 1 + 各类增伤合计: DMG bonus multiplier = 1 + total of all DMG bonuses
取攻击方命中时适用于本击的通用、属性、技能和状态增伤；同区相加。: Uses the general, elemental, skill and state DMG bonuses that apply to this hit from the attacker on hit; they add within the same zone.
易伤倍率 = 1 + 目标受伤提升合计: Vulnerability multiplier = 1 + total target DMG taken increase
只取本次受击目标在命中时有效的受伤提升 Debuff；不取攻击方增伤。: Uses only the DMG taken increase Debuffs active on this hit target at the moment of the hit; the attacker's DMG bonuses are not used.
未暴击 = 向下取整(完整精度伤害)；暴击 = 向下取整[完整精度伤害 × (1: Non-crit = floor(full-precision damage); crit = floor[full-precision damage × (1 + CRIT DMG)]; expectation = (1-r)×non-crit + r×crit
普通直伤取攻击方命中时暴击率；固定 50% 或不可暴击机制以正式策略覆盖。: Normal direct damage uses the attacker's CRIT rate on hit; fixed 50% or non-crit mechanics are overridden by the official policy.
取攻击方命中时暴击伤害；受击目标不提供此变量。: Uses the attacker's CRIT DMG on hit; the hit target does not provide this variable.
目标有效防御 = [防御基础×(1+防御提升)+固定防御]÷6×(1-防御穿透): Target effective DEF = [base DEF×(1+DEF increase)+flat DEF]÷6×(1-DEF penetration)×(1-DEF reduction); DEF multiplier = (character level+100)÷(target effective DEF+character level+100)
取本次伤害来源角色等级。: Uses the level of the character that dealt this damage.
取本次伤害来源角色命中时的防御穿透或防御无视。: Uses the DEF penetration or DEF ignore of the character that dealt this damage at the moment of the hit.
优先取本次受击目标冻结属性包的基础、百分比和固定防御。: Preferably uses the base, percentage and flat DEF from this hit target's frozen stat package.
取本次受击目标命中时有效的防御降低。: Uses the DEF reduction active on this hit target at the moment of the hit.
有效抗性 X = 基础抗性-减抗-属性穿透；X≥0 时抗性倍率=1-X；X<0: Effective RES X = base RES - RES reduction - elemental penetration; when X≥0 the RES multiplier is 1-X; when X<0 it is 1-X÷1.10
取本条正式伤害项或逐击已确认的实际属性。: Uses this official damage entry or the actual element confirmed for the hit.
取本次受击目标对该伤害属性的冻结战前抗性。: Uses this hit target's frozen pre-battle RES for this damage element.
取受击目标命中时有效、且匹配该属性的减抗。: Uses the RES reduction active on the hit target at the moment of the hit that matches this element.
取伤害来源角色命中时匹配该属性的穿透。: Uses the penetration of the character that dealt the damage that matches this element at the moment of the hit.
独立增伤 = 每个明确独立最终增伤逐项相乘: Independent DMG bonus = each explicitly independent final DMG bonus multiplied term by term
取正式效果中同时满足攻击方、受击目标、逐击标签与触发条件的最终增伤；逐项相乘。: Uses the final DMG bonuses from official effects that satisfy the attacker, hit target, per-hit tag and trigger conditions at the same time; multiplied term by term.
单次持续伤害 = 直伤同类乘区 × 状态层数 × 持续伤害专属增伤: Single damage over time tick = direct-damage-equivalent zones × state stacks × damage over time exclusive DMG bonus
攻击方提供技能倍率、面板、增伤、穿透和暴伤；受击目标提供防御、抗性、减益和易伤。: The attacker provides the skill ratio, panel, DMG bonus, penetration and CRIT DMG; the hit target provides defense, RES, debuffs and vulnerability.
取同半场、同一受击目标在本跳前的正式状态层数或受限结算系数。: Uses the official state stacks or limited settlement coefficient for the same half-scope and hit target before this tick.
取同一受击目标在本跳前仍有效、带正式 DOT 身份的种类数。: Uses the number of types still active with an official DOT identity on the same hit target before this tick.
倾陷伤害 = 等级曲线 × 倾陷强度 × 倾陷上限 × 防御 × 抗性: Break damage = level curve × Break Intensity × Break cap × defense × RES
团队中每名同半场角色分别取自己的等级对应倾陷曲线。: Each same-half-scope character in the team uses the Break curve for their own level.
每名角色分别取自己的倾陷强度和倾陷伤害提高。: Each character uses their own Break Intensity and Break DMG increase.
全队各格共同取本次受击目标的倾陷上限或冻结档位覆盖。: All slots in the team share this hit target's Break cap or frozen tier override.
每格穿透取该角色；防御、对应属性抗性和减益取受击目标。: Penetration per slot comes from that character; defense, matching elemental RES and debuffs come from the hit target.
覆纹追加 = 原伤害实际值 × [(复制比例 + 灵可复制比例加成) × (1: Hexed additional = actual original damage × [(copy ratio + Linko copy ratio bonus) × (1 + follow-up DMG bonus%) × intensity zone + clamp(intensity zone - 1, 0, 100)] × final multiplier
取被覆纹记录的攻击方真实伤害；正式 DOT 等可记录来源同样保留，不重新计算预计: Uses the attacker's real damage recorded by Hexed; recordable sources such as official DOT are also kept, and expected values are not recalculated.
取被记录原伤害的实际来源角色；不比较环合双方，也不固定取 QTE 触发者。: Uses the character that actually dealt the recorded original damage; neither side of the Cycle is compared and the QTE triggerer is not taken by default.
灵可复制比例加成 / 追击增伤%: Linko copy ratio bonus / follow-up DMG bonus%
弱点感应启用时各为 10%，未启用时各为 0%；(20% + 10%) × (1: Each is 10% when Weakness Radar is active and 0% when it is not; (20% + 10%) × (1 + 10%) = 33%.
当前 33% 的拆分解释；追击增伤只乘复制部分。游戏内部拆分尚未独立确认，其他来: The current decomposition interpretation of 33%; the follow-up DMG bonus multiplies only the copied portion. The in-game decomposition is not independently confirmed, and other sources are not substituted directly.
1 + 20% × 环合强度 / (环合强度 + 180)；环合强度最低按 0: 1 + 20% × Cycle Intensity / (Cycle Intensity + 180); Cycle Intensity counts as 0 at minimum.
把强度区减一的结果限制在 0 到 100 之间。: Clamps the result of the intensity zone minus one to between 0 and 100.
当前核心模型取 1；保留原伤已结算的增伤，不除掉原增伤区，也不将整次覆纹再乘 1: The current core model uses 1; the DMG bonuses already settled in the original damage are kept, the original DMG bonus zone is not divided out, and the whole Hexed instance is not multiplied by 1.10 again.
继承每条原伤害的实际属性；受击目标提供该属性抗性。: Inherits the actual element of each original damage instance; the hit target provides the RES for that element.
最终伤害 = 向下取整（不小于零的完整精度伤害）: Final damage = floor(full-precision damage not less than zero)
取该公式所有适用乘区相乘后的结果；中间过程不取整。: Uses the product of all applicable zones in this formula; intermediate steps are not rounded.
有效伤害 = 本次伤害 + 按当前生命比例折算的生命上限下降: Effective damage = this damage + the max HP reduction converted by the current HP ratio
取同半场、同一受击目标已确认的新旧最大生命前沿。: Uses the confirmed old and new max HP frontiers for the same half-scope and hit target.
取该目标生命上限下降前附近逐击的最小可靠当前生命。: Uses the smallest reliable current HP from nearby hits before that target's max HP reduction.
只在正式事件或已审计机制能绑定来源时归到角色；目标数据本身不证明来源。: Damage is attributed to a character only when an official event or audited mechanic can bind the source; target data alone does not prove the source.
汇总当前角色的人物、弧盘等正式基础值。: Aggregates the current character's character, Arc and other official base values.
把同属性百分比来源同区相加，再乘基础值。: Adds same-stat percentage sources within one zone, then multiplies by the base value.
最后加入同属性固定值来源。: Finally adds the same-stat flat sources.
用攻击方本条伤害项绑定的技能与有效技能等级选倍率档。: Selects the ratio tier from the skill bound to this damage entry of the attacker and the effective skill level.
筛选正式作用于本技能标签的倍率修正并相加。: Filters the ratio modifiers that officially apply to this skill tag and adds them.
用等级倍率乘以一加修正合计。: Multiplies the level ratio by one plus the total modifiers.
确认本击伤害项、缩放面板、属性、暴击策略与攻击方。: Confirms this hit's damage entry, scaling panel, element, CRIT policy and attacker.
依次计算技能倍率、面板、增伤、暴击、防御、抗性和易伤。: Computes the skill ratio, panel, DMG bonus, CRIT, defense, RES and vulnerability in order.
把每个适用的独立最终增伤逐项相乘。: Multiplies each applicable independent final DMG bonus term by term.
全程保留完整精度，只在最终出口向下取整。: Full precision is kept throughout, and rounding down happens only at the final exit.
按本击来源、属性、技能和状态标签筛选攻击方增伤。: Filters the attacker's DMG bonuses by this hit's source, element, skill and state tags.
同一增伤区内先相加。: They add within the same DMG bonus zone first.
合计加 1 得到增伤倍率。: Adding 1 to the total gives the DMG bonus multiplier.
筛选命中时仍有效且适用于本击的目标受伤提升。: Filters the target DMG taken increases that are still active on hit and apply to this hit.
同区相加后加 1 得到易伤倍率。: Adding them within the zone, then adding 1, gives the vulnerability multiplier.
先完成除暴击外的完整精度伤害。: Completes the full-precision damage excluding CRIT first.
按普通、固定暴击率、不可暴击或未知策略选择分支。: Selects the branch by normal, fixed CRIT rate, non-crit or unknown policy.
未暴击与暴击候选分别在最终出口取整，再按暴击率计算期望。: The non-crit and crit candidates are rounded separately at the final exit, then the expectation is computed from the CRIT rate.
从受击目标冻结属性包重建原始防御。: Rebuilds the raw defense from the hit target's frozen stat package.
应用攻击方防御穿透和目标防御降低。: Applies the attacker's DEF penetration and the target's DEF reduction.
用伤害来源角色等级计算最终防御倍率。: Computes the final DEF multiplier from the level of the character that dealt the damage.
按本击伤害属性读取受击目标对应基础抗性。: Reads the hit target's matching base RES for this hit's damage element.
减去目标动态减抗与攻击方对应属性穿透。: Subtracts the target's dynamic RES reduction and the attacker's matching elemental penetration.
根据有效抗性正负选择分段公式。: Selects the split formula according to the sign of the effective RES.
逐项核对正式效果的来源、目标、标签和触发条件。: Checks the official effects' source, target, tags and trigger conditions one by one.
每个满足条件的最终增伤先转为一加增量。: Each qualifying final DMG bonus is first converted into a plus-one increment.
